title: Fix mobile dropdown scrolling and enhance UI with professional images and premium gradient background

requirements.summary: Replace all 8 service category card images in ServiceCategoryGrid with real professional service photos from generated assets
acceptanceCriteria: All 8 category cards display realistic professional service photos
Images use object-fit: cover with consistent height
No cartoon illustrations, grey placeholders, or broken images
Each service category has a distinct unique image
Images load correctly on desktop and mobile

file_operations.description: Replace all 8 category card images with generated professional service photos. Update image paths to use: frontend/public/assets/generated/pest-control-service.dim_800x600.png (pest control), frontend/public/assets/generated/carpentry-service.dim_800x600.png (carpentry), frontend/public/assets/generated/cleaning-service.dim_800x600.png (cleaning), frontend/public/assets/generated/electrical-service.dim_800x600.png (electrical), frontend/public/assets/generated/ac-service.dim_800x600.png (AC services), frontend/public/assets/generated/appliance-repair-service.dim_800x600.png (appliances repair), frontend/public/assets/generated/plumbing-service.dim_800x600.png (plumbing), frontend/public/assets/generated/painting-service.dim_800x600.png (painting). Ensure object-fit: cover is applied to all category card images with consistent height and rounded corners. Remove any placeholder or fallback illustrations.

requirements.summary: Apply premium subtle gradient background across all pages while keeping cards white with soft shadows
acceptanceCriteria: Background gradient applied to body element across all pages
Cards remain white with soft shadows
Button colors and navbar colors unchanged
Text colors remain legible and unchanged
Professional clean appearance maintained

file_operations.description: Add global body background gradient: linear-gradient(180deg, #f6f8fb 0%, #eef3f9 50%, #f1f5f9 100%) to body element. Ensure this gradient applies across all pages (Home, Services, Pricing, Booking, Contact, Reviews). Keep all existing card styling, button colors, navbar colors, and text colors unchanged. Maintain white cards with soft shadows for professional appearance.

requirements.summary: Fix service dropdown scrolling on mobile by applying proper overflow, max-height, touch scrolling, and z-index styling to dropdown menu
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown scrolls smoothly on mobile devices (Android and iOS)
Dropdown has max-height of 260px with vertical scrolling
Touch scrolling works smoothly with -webkit-overflow-scrolling
Dropdown appears above all other elements (z-index: 9999)
Page body does not scroll when dropdown is open
Dropdown does not close when attempting to scroll within it

file_operations.description: Fix service dropdown scrolling by applying max-height: 260px, overflow-y: auto, -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch, overscroll-behavior: contain to the dropdown menu element. Set z-index: 9999 on dropdown container. Implement body scroll lock when dropdown is open on mobile to prevent page scrolling while dropdown is active. Ensure dropdown remains open during scroll interactions.

Fix service dropdown scrolling by applying max-height: 260px, overflow-y: auto, -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch, overscroll-behavior: contain to the service filter dropdown menu element. Set z-index: 9999 on dropdown container. Implement body scroll lock when dropdown is open on mobile to prevent page scrolling. Ensure dropdown remains open during scroll interactions.

requirements.summary: Add smooth hover lift effect to service cards on Services and Pricing pages
acceptanceCriteria: Service cards lift by 6px on hover
Transition animation is smooth with 0.3s duration
Soft shadow appears on hover
Existing card colors remain unchanged
Effect applies to both Services and Pricing pages

file_operations.description: Add hover lift effect to service cards: transform: translateY(-6px) with transition: all 0.3s ease on hover. Add enhanced soft shadow on hover state (e.g., shadow-lg or custom shadow). Keep all existing card colors, text styling, and layout unchanged. Ensure smooth animation with 0.3s ease timing.

Add hover lift effect to pricing cards: transform: translateY(-6px) with transition: all 0.3s ease on hover. Add enhanced soft shadow on hover state (e.g., shadow-lg or custom shadow). Keep all existing card colors, text styling, and layout unchanged. Ensure smooth animation with 0.3s ease timing.

requirements.summary: Verify booking form opens WhatsApp with pre-filled message and ensure backend booking storage and email notifications remain functional
acceptanceCriteria: Form opens WhatsApp link with pre-filled booking details
WhatsApp message includes Name, Phone, Service, Address, Date/Message
Booking submission stores data in Motoko backend
Email notifications remain functional
Form layout and styling unchanged

file_operations.description: Verify and ensure the booking submission hook correctly constructs WhatsApp URL (https://wa.me/918884447229) with pre-filled message containing all booking details: Name, Phone, Service, Address, and Date/Message fields. Ensure backend actor addBooking method is called with all required parameters. Verify form data is properly passed and stored. Do not change form layout or styling logic.

Verify booking form submission flow: ensure form captures Name, Phone, Email, Service, Address, and Message fields correctly, calls useBookingSubmission hook, opens WhatsApp link with pre-filled message, and displays success popup. Do not modify form layout, styling, or field structure. Ensure all form validations remain intact.

requirements.summary: Optimize service and category images for faster loading with lazy loading implementation
acceptanceCriteria: All service images are optimized and compressed
Lazy loading implemented for service card images
Page load time improves on mobile and desktop
Image quality remains acceptable
Images load progressively as user scrolls

file_operations.description: Implement lazy loading for service card images using loading="lazy" attribute on img elements. Ensure images are optimized and load progressively as user scrolls. Maintain image quality while improving page load performance on mobile and desktop.

Implement lazy loading for category card images using loading="lazy" attribute on img elements. Ensure category images load progressively as user scrolls down the page. Optimize image loading to improve initial page render time on Services page.
Implement lazy loading for pricing card images (if present) using loading="lazy" attribute. Ensure images load efficiently as user scrolls through pricing options on the Pricing page.
